name: Aquawalk Group Berhad
overview: Aquawalk Group Berhad 今年通过其全资子公司 Aquawalk (Indonesia) Sdn. Bhd. 与 PT Maju Batu Bersama 签订股东兼合资协议，在印度尼西亚东爪哇成立合资公司，以开发、拥有和运营一个新的海洋馆。这是公司今年在业务上的主要扩张动作，其余公告涉及股息、财报和股东大会等常规事项。
overview_en: Aquawalk Group Berhad this year, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Aquawalk (Indonesia) Sdn. Bhd., entered into a shareholders cum joint venture agreement with PT Maju Batu Bersama to incorporate a joint venture company in East Java, Indonesia, to undertake, own and operate a new oceanarium. This is the company's main business expansion this year; other announcements relate to dividends, financial results and general meetings.

segments.name: 旗舰私人水族馆
segments.note: 今年通过合资方式在印度尼西亚东爪哇拓展新的海洋馆项目。
segments.note_en: This year expanded into a new oceanarium project in East Java, Indonesia through a joint venture.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过合资公司在印度尼西亚东爪哇新增海洋馆业务，扩大旗舰私人水族馆业务的地理覆盖。
